title: The ratio read in the gap

aliases.name: R20 Raw values -> hold -> bracket -> multiple

members.role: the bars land with their raw values printed at their tops - each value the page's own, never a restating figure (R26-284)
after the raw values have been read and HELD, a bracket beside the bars spans the gap from the low top to the high one, the multiple (computed) its label

does: The bars land with their raw values and are held while the sentence reads them; only then a bracket spans the gap between the two tops and writes the multiple.

use_when.act: SPANS - two numbers read as a ratio (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R20)
use_when.shape: two numbers -> a ratio: two bars on one scale (a third between them may stand), both sourced
use_when.use: land both raw values, HOLD while they are said, then bracket and write the multiple (H row 16: the 2020-24 year's $28B -> 2026E's $150B, 5.4x)
use_when.dont: land the multiple before the raw values are read (STK held 14-16 s); an end on a CLAIM bar with a label that does not say whose (P73 T1: '36x on Patel's figure'); two data on different scales

source: P71 T34 (harvest v2 R20; STK 1:54-2:18 '6x', HIS 11:01 '5x'; A15's bracket on bars, P69 T50 closing R26-272); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t34.py on Steel and Paper H row 16 ('Between 2020 and 2024 ... big enough to bend the bond market', take 256.48 s) on the dossier's own three bars (EVIDENCE-DOSSIER.md C1), every value read off ev-debt-issuance-line-v1 - no approved cut carries it
